headline: Germany's DAX Drops Below 25,000 Points as Year-End Rally Halts
summary: Germany's DAX index fell 2%, sliding below the 25,000-point mark following a multi-session pullback of over 2,000 points. The move halted the equity market's year-end rally amid broader European stock declines.
why: The DAX index tracks 40 of the largest and most liquid German blue-chip companies listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange.

impacts.name: DAX
impacts.why: German equity benchmark dropped under broad European market selling pressure.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Widespread equity market profit-taking across Europe pressured major regional stock benchmarks lower.
